Campus Accessibility Project Statistics: • This project, would provide dedicated resources to improve campus access to persons with disabilities. Projects include restroom improvements, exterior pedestrian improvements, and discrete building improvements such as elevator modernizations. URI has 80 elevators. Of these, 19 are more than 30 years old and only 18 are newer than 10 years. Many of our buildings are served by single units. The combination of single units and aged equipment often results in downtime and limits access. This level of support would allow for the modernization of 2-3 units per year or the replacement of one. • $ 16,500,000 - RICAP • Status: Initial Funding Approved • Start 2025 • Complete 2030 Elevator Modernization Ongoing Approved Project Accessibility Improvements

TO: The University of Rhode Island Board of Trustees, Ad Hoc Special Real Estate Committee FROM: Marc B. Parlange, Ph.D., P.Eng., President DATE: June 26, 2025 SUBJECT: Discussion Item: Update on the Comprehensive Campus Plan Purpose of Submittal: To update the Committee on the progress of the Comprehensive Campus Plan (CCP). Points to Consider: In June of 2024 the University, with Sasaki, kicked off the Comprehensive Campus Plan. • Phase 1 - Discovery and Analysis was completed in October 2024. • Phase 2 - Planning Scenarios were mostly completed in January 2025. • Phase 3 - Campus Plan Development January 2025 - June 2025. • Phase 4 - Final Documentation (July 2025-September 2025). This presentation will provide an overview of the draft final plan, which is in support of the University’s strategic plan. This overview will discuss a framework for the redevelopment of campus, future vision for Kingston campus neighborhoods, open space and landscape opportunities, mobility and circulation strategies , and sustainability initiatives. This overview will also provide a vision for the Narragansett Bay Campus, building on its existing master plan. Feedback from the Board will be incorporated by Sasaki and the URI Planning team as they finalize the plan over the summer. The plan will be brought to the Board for approval in September.
